offering_description.value: Covista provides degree programs for aspiring and practicing nurses, graduate students, and future physicians and veterinarians. Its universities deliver online and campus-based instruction and arrange supervised clinical training through affiliated sites.

primary_services.value: Nursing education; graduate and professional education; medical education; veterinary education

customer_segment.value: B2C: Aspiring and practicing nurses, graduate students, medical students and veterinary students; B2B: Hospitals and health systems that sponsor employee education

end_markets.value: Nursing and allied health; behavioral health and social services; education and business; medicine; veterinary care

revenue_model.value: service fees: Tuition and academic fees for undergraduate, graduate and professional degree programs

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Combines faculty instruction and clinical placements to deliver degree programs to students and employer-sponsored learners; asset operator: Operates university campuses, laboratories and simulation facilities for students in health professions

geography_served.value: global: United States, Barbados, Sint Maarten, and Saint Kitts and Nevis

specialization.value: related lines: Nursing, graduate and professional studies, medicine and veterinary medicine

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Degree programs are subject to operating approvals, institutional and programmatic accreditation, and U.S. federal student aid rules.
